description: A Java class for rendering a 2D triangle using OpenGL ES 2.0 in an Android application. The class encapsulates shader code, buffer setup, and draw routines to render a triangle with specified color and transformations.

classes.name: Triangle
classes.description: Defines a drawable triangle object for OpenGL ES rendering in Android, including shader setup, buffer initialization, and draw method.

methods.name: Triangle
methods.description: Constructor that initializes vertex buffers, compiles shaders, and links the OpenGL program.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Executes the OpenGL ES commands to render the triangle using the provided Model View Projection matrix.
